name: echo terminal glow
description: Proposal, hacker life at night, 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x moved left beside a steel desk and a terminal) in a dark room lit only by the screen: its right side and the right of its visor take the screen's light, a dithered teal halo falls on the wall and the floor, and the cursor blinks on the live line; the hand dips onto the keyboard and blocks land on the line one a frame, the glow and the halo widening with every key, enter scrolls the screen up and the output dashes arrive fast with an antenna ping, it glances out at the room and back, types a second command and its output scrolls in, and the glow settles back to the first frame; judge whether the light reads as coming from the screen, whether the typing reads as typing at 12 px cells, whether the lines read as glow and never as text, and whether it is still this creature.
